title: Decision storage strategy: filesystem-first, DB-later index
context: Current environment has no dedicated decision database, but decisions must remain traceable across interrupted sessions.
decision: Use filesystem decision records as authoritative source now; introduce DB indexing only after contract and governance model stabilize.
consequences: Git history and pull requests provide immediate auditability without infra dependency.
Searchability is acceptable for early stage via file naming and generated reports.
A later DB index can mirror files for query performance without changing authority source.
notes: Revisit when decision records exceed manual review comfort threshold.
